title: CLO Internship Life Revealed - I heard someone has regrets!? 👀
description:
🎓 Three rising stars in the fashion industry have embarked on a journey from the campuses of Shanghai into the digital fashion world of CLO. Let's see if their stories can ignite the spark of fashion within you.

At CLO, you'll discover that digitization is not just a solution, but a mindset that allows for bolder designs and sustainable fashion. At CLO, you can learn not only about the digital processing of fabrics but also explore how to use 3D technology to create designs that are both realistic and creative. By building 3D scenes, you can achieve virtual fashion shows that bring clothing to life...

This internship journey offers profound insights into the future trends of the fashion industry. Through digital transformation, the fashion industry can achieve both efficiency and cost improvements!

📣 If you are passionate about the digitalization of fashion and eager to leave your mark in the industry, CLO awaits your exploration! We look forward to seeing more talented individuals create their own fashion universe with CLO! 🪐🌠🚀

summary: ```markdown # CLO Internship Life Revealed - I Heard Someone Has Regrets!? ## Introduction Hello, everyone. I'm Li Xiaoyu, an intern. I've been an intern for two months. Do you want to know about our internship life? ## Background Information Hi, my name is Li Xiaoyu. I'm from Shanghai Engineering University. I majored in Fashion and Art Design. I'm currently studying at Yan San University and will graduate in June 2025. Before I came here, I had been studying at Close 3D for nearly three years and also took an advanced certificate from Close 3D. ## Meet My Colleague Hello, everyone. I'm Chen Luming. I'm from Donghua University's Fashion and Art Design School. I'm a student in the Chinese-Japanese cooperation major. I took an entrance exam in July this year and came to the Close company for an internship. My main job is to measure food. ## Internship Experience at Close 3D What kind of life does it take to be an intern at Close 3D? I started my internship with training, dealing with fabric digitization. The accuracy of fabric digitization is very important for the restoration of virtual clothing. ### Preparation for Internship For those who plan to come to Close 3D for an internship, my suggestion is to have a certain initial ability. Close 3D will have an initial ability assessment before the internship. Everyone can learn related videos on Close 3D's Bilibili and public account. You can record your own problems. If you have the opportunity to come to an internship, you can solve your own problems very accurately and quickly, which will help you improve your skills. ### Learning and Development Before coming to Close 3D, I did not practice the processing of fabric, physics, and textiles. I just listened to how to operate in class. After coming to Close 3D, I had the guidance and training of all the teachers, allowing me to practice better. ## Understanding Fabric In terms of fabric, it is divided into physics and textiles. Physical processing is mainly for stretch and curve. The thickness of the fabric can be measured, including weight and thickness, which are essential for making approvals. ### Particle Processing For particle processing, it is mainly used to make precision scanning. This can be applied to all forms of software in order to create more realistic real-time images. A lot of different types of fabric can be executed in Close 3D, making the tunneling of the product truly interesting. ## Creative Aspirations In this process, I want to create materials that may not exist in the real world. This can add a lot of design fun and open up possibilities for creativity. I hope to improve my level of virtual fashion production in the future. Additionally, I plan to integrate some of the other software and 3D scenes into the cloud, allowing for cloud walkthroughs and making the clothes move. ## Future of the Clothing Industry What do you think of the future development of the clothing industry? I believe that, as a more traditional industry, clothing needs digital intervention in all aspects to achieve efficiency and a double harvest in cost. The clothing industry is currently moving towards virtualization, which is a direction we are pursuing. ### Advantages of Virtualization There are two main advantages to this approach: no physical fabric is needed, which makes the process convenient and efficient. We no longer have to engage in lengthy factory processing, allowing us to design quickly and achieve bold, innovative effects. Furthermore, since we don't need real fabric, we can avoid material waste and address environmental issues. ## Personal Plans What are your future plans? My first major was not in clothing, but I found that it is deeply connected to our lives, which sparked my interest. I plan to improve myself through competitions, and my work will be featured in the digital show at Beijing Fashion Week this September. My future plans are still in the clothing industry, particularly focusing on the digitalization of clothing. I aim to advance further in this field. ## Conclusion Hello everyone, I am Andy, a technical expert at Colossandy. As one of the managers of this intern training, I have witnessed their pursuit and love for new technology and innovations. Now, they can complete daily internship tasks with quality and efficiency. I believe they have gained a deeper understanding of new technology and digitalization in the clothing industry. After graduation, they will be well-equipped to enter the industry and contribute positively to its development. ```
